column5: Imagine you're lying on a beach.
Now Earth starts falling toward it.
Ten percent closer, and the sunlight is already a quarter stronger.
The sand burns under your feet.
At half the distance, the Sun looks twice as wide.
Your skin would burn in minutes.
At a quarter of the distance, sixteen times the sunlight.
They start to smoke, then catch fire.
Earth only works because of exactly where it is.
